title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.11 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE allowed authenticated users with developer-role permissions to bypass security policies and self-approve their own merge requests, merging code into protected branches. This issue affected versions from 18.11 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2. The flaw was due to incorrect authorization logic when a security policy prohibited author self-approval. GitLab has remediated this issue in the specified fixed versions.
